feature_title: Logs Build Query — Apply Saved View

rationale.edition: The only changed path is web/src/plugins/logs/BuildQueryPage.vue, which is a standard open-source frontend path. It is not under any enterprise-owned directory (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) and carries no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management), so the change is OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no explicit opt-out (feature_hint and trigger_comment are both empty, no tests-added label) and the change is user-facing frontend behavior in web/src/**, so the no-user-facing-change skip does not apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the diff adds a watcher on searchObj.meta.savedBuildConfig so that applying a saved view while already on the Build Query tab re-initializes the page (previously onMounted never re-read it). That is a user-exercisable UI flow change that needs verification.
rationale.area: Logs. The changed file lives in web/src/plugins/logs/ (the Logs Build Query page) and sibling specs for that page live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/.
rationale.group: Logs-Features is the closest existing matrix shard: its actual_folder is Logs and it already contains logsQueryBuilder.spec.js and monaco-query-prefill.spec.js, which cover the Build Query page this change touches. (Note: ci_matrix.json does not exist in this repo; I read the equivalent tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_cloud.json.)
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — the only changed file is a .vue component, not a tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/**/*.spec.js file.
